title: An IMRep whose weighted orientation is p₁θ₁ξ₁1_{M₁} + p₂θ₂ξ₂1_{M₂} a.e.
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂) be IMReps in U (Simon Ch. 6, 3.1) and p₁, p₂ ∈ ℤ. Then there is an IMRep R = (M', θ', ξ') in U such that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) the n-vectors satisfy 1_{M'}(x)θ'(x)ξ'(x) = p₁1_{M₁}(x)θ₁(x)ξ₁(x) + p₂1_{M₂}(x)θ₂(x)ξ₂(x) (written with Set.indicator and scalar multiplication in MultiVector P n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), IsOpen U → ∃ R : IMRep U n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = (p₁ : ℝ) • R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + (p₂ : ℝ) • R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x
